title: Verlintas/NOIR
body:
手机隐私审计：用 adb 扫出 Android 应用的权限、上报端点与数据流向，并给出可回滚的处置。Desktop Android leak audit: permissions, endpoints, data flows, reversible fixes.

README 節錄：``` ███╗ ██╗ ██████╗ ██╗██████╗ ████╗ ██║██╔═══██╗██║██╔══██╗ ██╔██╗ ██║██║ ██║██║██████╔╝ ██║╚██╗██║██║ ██║██║██╔══██╗ ██║ ╚████║╚██████╔╝██║██║ ██║ ╚═╝ ╚═══╝ ╚═════╝ ╚═╝╚═╝ ╚═╝ ``` # NOIR **把「这台手机到底能泄露什么」变成一份可复现的报告。** NOIR 是一个跑在电脑上的审计工具，通过 `adb` 读取已连接 Android 设备的应用清单、权限和 APK 里的网络端点，给出分类、风险评分和可执行的处置建议。它也可以在需要时调用 `jadx` 对单个应用做反编译和关键字检索。 > 定位：**审计与自我防护**。面向自己的设备、自己的应用、已授权的安全研究。 **官网 / Website:** https://verlintas.dev/noir/ · 中文 **AtomGit 镜像 / Mirror:** https://atomgit.com/Verlintas/NOIR --- ## 它做什么 1. **盘点**：列出所有「有网络权限 + 敏感权限」的应用，以及它们各自拿到了什么。 2. **抽取端点**：在设备端用 `unzip + strings` 从每个 APK 的 dex 里提取 URL，只回传几 KB，不把整包拉回电脑。 3. **分类与打分**：按包名和域名识别厂商（Xiaomi / Google / 腾讯 / 高德 …）与类别（遥测、广告、定位、输入法 …），结合权限和上报端点计算风险分。 4. **数据关联**：把权限翻译成"能拿到什么数据"（位置/通讯录/短信/通话/麦克风/相机/屏幕/应用列表/设备标识/文件/日历/账号），再和上报域名配对，得出"哪类数据可能流向哪里"。 5. **共享 UID**：识别 `android.uid.system` 这类共享用户，列出哪些包实际上共享同一套权限并集。 6. **清单层**：解析 `AndroidManifest.xml` 二进制 AXML，找出没有权限保护的导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable、targetSdk。 4. **给建议**：区分「可安全自动执行」「需人工确认」「不建议动」，并为每条动作生成回滚命令。 5. **必要时深挖**：`deep` 会把单个 APK 拉到本地，用 `jadx` 反编译后检索 `Runtime.exec`、`setApplicationEnabledSetting`、`DexClassLoader`、`MediaProjection` 等高风险调用。 ## 它不做什么 - 不联网、不上传任何数据、不需要账号。 - 不修改系统分区，不需要 root。 - 不会自动卸载任何东西，除非你显式加 `--aggressive`。 --- ## 第一次运行 ```bash noir ``` 不带参数会进入向导： 1. 检查 `adb`，没有就**问你要不要自动下载**（`~/.noir/tools`） 2. 检查设备，没有就打印**开发者模式 / USB 调试的开通步骤

title: zortos293/Lichii
body:
VERY experimental Nintendo Switch 2 emulator

README 節錄： # Lichii Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. ## Downloads and setup Published builds belong on this fork's releases page. The repository still uses its historical Eglantine name; the desktop application is now Lichii. On Windows, extract the entire build archive and run **lichii.exe**. Only use games and system files you have legally obtained. Games, keys and firmware are not included. ### Existing saves and settings The rebrand intentionally retains the existing Eden/Eglantine data directories and configuration keys. It does not move or delete saves, settings or shader caches. Back up your saves before testing experimental builds. ## Compatibility and issue reports Compatibility and performance vary by game, hardware and driver. Rendering errors, stutters and crashes remain possible. Passing automated tests does not establish that a game renders correctly, and this project makes no universal frame-rate guarantee. title: govijr/terminal-mac
body:
Entire MacOS running in your terminal.

README 節錄：# terminal-mac A separate macOS desktop for computer-use agents, viewed and controlled from a terminal. `terminal-mac` is an early release candidate for Apple silicon. Apple Virtualization runs a real macOS guest. A bundled helper **inside that guest** captures its screen and posts input events. A terminal viewer streams that screen using Kitty or iTerm2 graphics. Agent commands use the same helper without moving the physical Mac's pointer or changing its clipboard. The guest is a separate Mac: it has its own apps, files, accounts and permissions. It does not inherit your running host apps or signed-in sessions. The VM still consumes host CPU, memory and storage. ## Requirements - Apple silicon Mac, macOS 14 or later. - No development tools are needed for a prebuilt release. Maintainers need Xcode 16 or later / Swift 6 to build. - Internet on first run to download macOS directly from Apple, or an existing compatible `.ipsw`. - Space for the cached restore image and a growing VM disk (64 GiB logical size by default). - Ghostty, Kitty or iTerm2 for the inline viewer. Other terminals can use the native VM window and agent CLI. tmux passthrough and automatic terminal splits are not implemented. ## Install and run ```sh curl -fsSL https://github.com/govijr/terminal-mac/releases/latest/download/get.sh | bash ``` The installer downloads the latest release and verifies its SHA-256 before installing. You can also extract a release ZIP

title: andrew-babo/muse4ai
body:
Muse4AI — let your AI agent make the pictures and the videos. Local Windows bridge for Muse via REST, MCP, and OAuth.

README 節錄： # Muse4AI **Let your AI agent make the pictures and the videos.** Muse4AI runs on your own Windows PC and hands your Muse session to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Codex, n8n or anything else that speaks **REST**, **MCP** or **OAuth** — with no cloud middleman and no per-seat fee. **Website** · **Download** · **Guide** · **For agents** · Tiếng Việt --- ## How it fits together ```text ChatGPT · Claude · Cursor · Codex · n8n · your own script │ │ REST · MCP · OAuth ▼ ┌─────────────────────┐ │ Muse4AI on your PC│ local library, queue, │ (Windows app) │ keys, tokens, history └─────────────────────┘ │ │ your own signed-in Muse session ▼ Muse ``` Nothing is relayed through a server we run. The app talks to Muse from your machine, with your session, and keeps every result, key and token in `%APPDATA%\MuseStudio` on that same machine. ## What you can ask an agent to do 🎬 Generate video & images One call, text-only or with reference photos. Repeat a prompt, pick the account, watch it appear in the in-app queue. 💬 Chat that remembers Ask questions or iterate on an idea. The conversation id comes back, so the agent can keep the thread going and attach files. ⏱ Extend a finished video Keep a clip rolling, up to 6 steps and about 60 seconds per chain, in the same conversation it was born in. 🛠 Edit a video by describing it Attach an MP4 and say what to change

title: AssassinCreator/steam-stash-value-report-card
body:
Value your Steam stash in the terminal and print it as a share card: per game, per market, what sold and what sits. One Windows portable build, no account.

README 節錄： ```text $ stashcard paste a profile -> pick a card -> get a PNG worth posting ``` **Stashcard** values a Steam account and its inventories (CS2, Dota 2, TF2, Rust, Steam community items or any custom app) from your terminal, prices them on Steam and on the big cash marketplaces, and prints the result as a shareable card: a report card, a game card, an inventory picture, a thermal receipt, a marketplace comparison, or a then-vs-now / A-vs-B diff. Every number carries its venue and window. `LOWEST` is the floor listing right now. `AVG` is the mean of real sales over a window you pick. Steam money is wallet funds; everything else is cash, and the two are never mixed silently. When a source has nothing, Stashcard falls back and says so on the row, in the totals and in the card footer. Nothing unpriced is ever counted as zero. Free and open source. No accounts, no paid APIs, no telemetry. > [!TIP] > **Run Stashcard on your home PC. Windows is the recommended setup.** Steam rate-limits datacenter, > VPS and cloud IPs heavily, so live scans from a server are unreliable. On a server only the demo and > cached data work reliably. See Where to run it. --- ## Download | System | File | | |---|---|---| | Windows 10 and 11 | `steam-stash-value-report-card.zip` | One zip. No installer, no admin rights | Unpack the whole fold

title: joeblau/subvox
body: README 節錄：# Subvox A macOS prototype that tests whether AirPods Pro head-motion data (`CMHeadphoneMotionManager`) carries enough information to turn **silently mouthed words into text**. It doesn't use a language model. It's a small-vocabulary template recognizer plus a statistical test that tells you whether the signal is real. ## Build & run ```sh brew install xcodegen # once xcodegen generate open Subvox.xcodeproj # ⌘R ``` Or from the command line: ```sh xcodebuild -project Subvox.xcodeproj -scheme Subvox -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates build open build/Build/Products/Debug/Subvox.app xcodebuild -project Subvox.xcodeproj -scheme Subvox -derivedDataPath build test ``` Requires macOS 14+, AirPods Pro or another headphone that supports head tracking, connected as the Mac's audio output. On first launch, grant **Motion**. The mic and speech prompts only appear when you start the mic. ## Screens | Screen | What it does | |---|---| | **Sensors** | Live plots of user acceleration, rotation rate and attitude, the measured sample rate, a mic input picker and level meter, and a recorder for experiment sessions. | | **Train** | Pick a word, hold **Space**, mouth it, release. Each take is stored as a template. **Evaluate** runs leave-one-out classification and a 500× label-permutation test, then shows accuracy against chance, a p-value and a confusion matrix. The feature checkboxes (acceleration / rotation / attitude) let you test which channels carry the signal. |

On the Switch, go to "System" menu and change system language to English(US). Go to "Controllers & Accessories" menu and change USB Keyboard to English(US). title: Balanov/uncut
body:
The lossless, headless coding agent harness. One 7 MB static binary, four tools, plain stdin/stdout, no silent cuts.

README 節錄： UNCUT The lossless, headless coding agent harness. One 7 MB static binary, four tools, plain stdin/stdout. No TUI. No telemetry. No silent context cuts. Linux · macOS · Windows · amd64 + arm64 · MIT Landing page: balanov.pro/uncut UNCUT is a tiny coding-agent harness for shell pipelines, CI jobs, containers, and agent experiments. It deliberately has no TUI, telemetry, plugin system, background agents, automatic retries, or context compaction. The entire conversation is sent on every model call. File contents and combined command output are never truncated by UNCUT. If the provider cuts a response at its output limit, UNCUT exits with an error instead of presenting a partial answer as success. Run the proof yourself or inspect the recorded measurements. ## Why UNCUT? - **Lossless by default.** No summarization, pruning, sliding windows, or silent output caps. - **Headless only.** Final text goes to stdout; structured NDJSON events are available with `--json`. - **Small and portable.** One statically linked Go binary, no runtime or third-party Go dependencies. - **Provider neutral.** Works with OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints, including local servers. - **Resumable.** Optional append-only JSONL sessions preserve every message and tool result. - **Forkable.** 837 lines of implementation Go, four tools, one provider protocol, one agent loo
